village_odilia_cleanup.m: Everything's out of place, left exactly as it was when we... when we vanished. It's eerie, really. We'll need everyone's help to tidy up and get the village back to how it was. But first, we need to clear away the webs and rot.

village_odilia_start.m: Thank you for rescuing us earlier!
r: How did the troll manage to capture all of you without anyone noticing?
What about you? How are you doing?

wexlow_odilia_explain_capture.m: The well was enchanted. We felt a strange compulsion to visit it, especially when alone.

wexlow_odilia_explain_capture_1.m: The well has been enchanted by the troll. Anyone who draws water from it feels an inexplicable compulsion to keep returning.
r: And you were one to draw water from the well?

wexlow_odilia_explain_capture_2.m: Yes and every night, I would awake to find myself at the well with no memory of how I got there.

wexlow_odilia_explain_capture_3.m: Yes. This happened many times before that thing finally got me.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
